title: Triage eight service logs
prompt: logs/ holds 8 log files, one for each service (the file name is the service). Each line is: time, level, request id, message. Write triage.json: an object with one key for each service, holding {"errors": how many lines have the level ERROR, "first_failing_request": the request id of the first such line in the file}. The word ERROR inside a message does not count.
